title: Feature · ship and retire a product-authorized SwiftPM library-product experiment
description: Govern Vaporize's library-only SwiftPM build/test capability through intersecting product and repository authority, staged source-analysis and implementation decisions, a frozen accepted modification snapshot, expiring per-boundary worker leases, dark implementation, candidate persistence before independently authorized delivery and environment policy-plane exposure, persisted analytics, human disposition, new decision-bound cleanup authority, mandatory temporary-selection and losing-code removal, cleanup persistence, operational retirement, capability finalization, and governance-only closure.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing library-only bead remains the implementation child. Product approval and Vaporize repository-owner delegation precede source access; implementation acceptance does not imply delivery or exposure; rollback and one exact-file candidate Savepoint precede exposure; delivery.execute is delegated by the delivery owner; feature.policy.write, feature.exposure.execute, and rollback.execute are delegated by each environment policy-plane owner; one independently owned lease and receipt chain expands per environment/cohort target and all targets fan in before analytics, disposition, cleanup, or closure; push and publish remain repository-owner decisions; persisted analytics precede disposition; disposition mints new cleanup authority; cleanup is persisted and operationally retired; evidence remains immutable; every lease-issuing phase has an independently reachable non-success finalizer; and all capabilities are revoked before governance-only closure persistence.
notes: This graph is the first planning exemplar for the product-scoped code-change proposal. It does not itself grant source access while the Beads gate, lease, broker, and Savepoint enforcement repairs remain open.
